description: Source code for purchase order and purchase order line management in an Odoo module, including class definitions, fields, and methods for order processing.

classes.name: purchase_order_line
classes.description: Model extending 'purchase.order.line' with additional fields and methods for order line status, invoicing, and copying data.

classes.name: purchase_order
classes.description: Model extending 'purchase.order' with methods for invoice creation and order confirmation, and a custom order name field.

methods.name: copy_data
methods.description: Overrides copy_data to reset order line state, invoiced status, and invoice lines.

methods.name: action_confirm
methods.description: Confirms purchase order lines by setting their state to 'confirmed'.

methods.name: action_invoice_create
methods.description: Creates invoices for purchase orders and marks order lines as invoiced.

methods.name: wkf_confirm_order
methods.description: Confirms the purchase order and its draft order lines.
